lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately five distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The blobs in the mid-flank (left side of image) exhibit larger diameters and greater inter-blob spacing compared to the smaller, higher-density clusters proximal to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, providing a structural axis for the vertical columns of blobs, most notably in the mid-lateral region where the grid-like alignment is most regular.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient running parallel to the longitudinal axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four small, yellow-hued teleost fish (likely pilot fish) localized near the mid-flank and the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
